description: Make issue archive a visibility-only operation that preserves the workflow run reference, rename the domain's ActiveWorkflowRunId to a neutral WorkflowRunId, decouple active-workflow control/reconciliation judgments from reference presence, and keep archived issues fully readable across API and Web.

tasks.title: Rename ActiveWorkflowRunId to WorkflowRunId and stop clearing the reference on archive/close
tasks.description: In Domain.Issue, collapse the dual ActiveWorkflowRunId ([JsonIgnore]) / WorkflowRunId properties into a single WorkflowRunId property backed by _workflowRunId, and remove the [JsonIgnore] alias. Change Issue.Archive() and Issue.Close() so they no longer null the reference (only ClearStoppedWorkflow, used at start-reuse time on InProgress issues, may clear it). Unarchive stays as clearing archivedAt only. Rename the field/property/usages across the domain and update WorkflowProfileLockedException wording and log text from 'active workflow' to 'workflow run reference' where they describe the reference. The public JSON key (workflowRunId) and the IssueRow computed column are unchanged, so no data migration is needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Domain.Issue exposes a single WorkflowRunId property and no ActiveWorkflowRunId symbol remains in packages/server/src
Archiving a Done issue bound to wr_1 leaves WorkflowRunId == wr_1 and sets archivedAt
Closing an issue bound to wr_1 leaves WorkflowRunId == wr_1
Unarchive clears only archivedAt and does not alter WorkflowRunId
Existing rows deserialize correctly (JSON key workflowRunId/WorkflowRunId unchanged); no schema migration required
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds with warnings-as-errors
Unit tests cover: archive preserves reference, close preserves reference, unarchive clears only archivedAt, round-trip serialization
tasks.output: Updated Domain.Issue / Issue.Transitions.cs / WorkflowProfileLockedException and domain unit tests
tasks.notes: Foundation task. Implements design decisions D1 and D2. Public JSON contract is already workflowRunId so this is an internal-only rename with no external break.

tasks.title: Decouple active-workflow control and reconciliation judgments from reference presence
tasks.description: Introduce an explicit derived IsWorkflowControllable judgment on the grain (Status == InProgress && workflowRunId != null && run is not stopped/terminal) and use it wherever code means 'is there a running workflow to control' — notably IssueGrain.CancelAsync should only run the cannot-close-while-running status check when the workflow is actually controllable, and TryReuseActiveWorkflowAsync should keep its start-time-only behavior under the renamed local. Keep the profile-lock guard using workflowRunId != null as the 'has started' signal (unchanged behavior). Add an IsArchived stored computed column to IssueRow (json_extract(State,'$.archivedAt') IS NOT NULL, modeled on the existing WorkflowRunId computed column) and change IssueWorkflowReconciliationService candidate query to Where(i => i.WorkflowRunId != null && !i.IsArchived) so archived issues are never selected as stuck-run candidates; the per-grain Status != InProgress guard stays as defense-in-depth.
acceptanceCriteria: A Done/archived issue with a preserved workflowRunId is not treated as having an active controllable workflow by CancelAsync (no spurious cannot-close-while-running check; Close() still rejects Done/archived)
IssueWorkflowReconciliationService candidate query excludes archived issues at the SQL level (IsArchived computed column added and filtered)
An InProgress issue with a non-null workflowRunId is still reconciled by the sweep
Profile-lock guard still rejects workflowProfileId changes when workflowRunId != null (has-started semantics preserved)
EF migration adding the IsArchived computed column applies cleanly with no data backfill
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds; tests cover archived-issue-not-swept, cancel-on-done-with-reference, in-progress-still-swept, profile-lock-still-applies
tasks.output: Updated IssueGrain (derived judgment, Cancel/reuse paths), IssueWorkflowReconciliationService, MohistDbContext + IssueRow IsArchived column, EF migration, and tests
tasks.notes: Implements design decisions D3 and D4. Distinguishes 'has started' (reference presence, profile lock) from 'is active' (status+run-state, control/reconciliation).

tasks.title: Keep archived-issue detail API exposing the workflow run reference and full history
tasks.description: After T-001 stops clearing the reference, verify and lock the read path: IssueQuerier already projects issue.WorkflowRunId into the response and joins timeline/artifacts/events/feedback by workflowRunId, so update the mapper to the renamed property and add API regression coverage asserting an archived Done issue returns its workflowRunId, archivedAt, timeline, artifacts, events, and feedback with the same shape as a non-archived issue, and that no active-workflow indicator is surfaced solely from reference presence.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/issues/:n for an archived Done issue returns workflowRunId of the completed run and a set archivedAt
Workflow timeline, artifacts, events, and feedback sub-resources return the same shape for archived and non-archived Done issues
The archived detail response does not indicate an active/running workflow solely because workflowRunId is present
dotnet build Mohist.sln succeeds; API regression tests cover archived-detail-returns-reference, archived-detail-exposes-history, and no-false-active-indicator
tasks.output: Updated IssueRowMapper/IssueQuerier property reference and API regression tests
tasks.notes: Read path needs no logic change beyond the rename (design D5); this task mainly adds regression coverage for the http-api capability.

tasks.title: Render full workflow execution history on the archived issue detail page
tasks.description: Ensure the Web issue detail page renders the workflow timeline, artifacts, events, and feedback for an archived issue from its preserved workflowRunId using the same rendering path as a non-archived issue, differing only in visibility/list placement. Ensure no active-workflow control surface (start/stop/retry) is presented as if the workflow were running for an archived/Done issue. The standalone Archived list data-fetch bug is explicitly out of scope unless it blocks rendering the detail page.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the detail page of an archived Done issue renders the workflow timeline for its preserved workflowRunId
Artifacts, events, and feedback sections render identically to a non-archived Done issue
No active-workflow controls (start/stop/retry) are shown as active for an archived issue
Web typecheck and tests pass
tasks.output: Updated issue detail page rendering and Web tests
tasks.notes: Consumes the API guarantee from T-003. Standalone Archived-list取数 bug is a non-goal per the issue.
